rules.label: tax-w2
rules.name: W-2 Wage and Tax Statement
rules.instruction: A W-2 Wage and Tax Statement. The page is dominated by a large heading reading 'Form W-2' and 'Wage and Tax Statement'. It is a U.S. federal tax form showing an employee's annual wages and the taxes withheld by an employer for a tax year. It contains numbered boxes such as 'Box 1 Wages, tips, other compensation', 'Box 2 Federal income tax withheld', 'Box 3 Social security wages', and 'Box 6 Medicare tax withheld', along with an Employer EIN and an Employee SSN. Match ONLY a W-2 tax form. Do NOT match a pay stub or earnings statement (those cover a single pay period, not a full tax year, and have no numbered W-2 boxes).

stages.ask: Is this page a Form W-2 Wage and Tax Statement? Look for the bold heading 'Form W-2', the phrase 'Wage and Tax Statement', numbered boxes (Box 1, Box 2, ...), an Employer EIN, and an Employee SSN.

is_w2.description: yes if this is a W-2 Wage and Tax Statement form, otherwise no

doc_type.description: a short kebab-case token naming the document type
doc_type.values: a short kebab-case token, e.g. wage-tax-statement

year.description: the 4-digit tax year shown on the form

rules.label: utility-electric
rules.name: Electric Utility Bill
rules.instruction: An electric utility bill. The page header names a power/electric company (for example 'Springfield Power & Light') and carries the words 'ELECTRICITY BILL'. It shows a service address, an account number, a billing date, a service period, electricity usage measured in kWh, a charge summary with line items, and a bold 'TOTAL AMOUNT DUE'. Match ONLY a residential electricity/utility bill. Do NOT match a bank statement or an insurance document.

stages.ask: Is this page an electric utility bill? Look for a power/electric company name in the header, the words 'ELECTRICITY BILL', a service address, electricity usage in kWh, and a 'TOTAL AMOUNT DUE'.

is_electric_bill.description: yes if this is an electric utility bill, otherwise no

doc_type.description: a short kebab-case token naming the document type
doc_type.values: a short kebab-case token, e.g. electric-bill

year.description: the 4-digit year of the billing date

rules.label: bank-statement
rules.name: Bank Account Statement
rules.instruction: A monthly bank account statement. The header names a bank (for example 'First Sample Bank') and reads 'MONTHLY ACCOUNT STATEMENT'. It shows an account holder, a partly-masked account number (e.g. 'Checking ****0000'), a statement period, a beginning balance, an ending balance, and a dated transaction history table with withdrawal and deposit columns. Match ONLY a bank/checking account statement. Do NOT match a pay stub, an electric bill, or a W-2.

stages.ask: Is this page a monthly bank account statement? Look for a bank name, 'MONTHLY ACCOUNT STATEMENT', a statement period, beginning and ending balances, and a transaction history table with withdrawal/deposit columns.

is_bank_statement.description: yes if this is a bank account statement, otherwise no

doc_type.description: a short kebab-case token naming the document type
doc_type.values: a short kebab-case token, e.g. account-statement

year.description: the 4-digit year of the statement period

rules.label: pay-stub
rules.name: Pay Stub / Earnings Statement
rules.instruction: A pay stub, also called an earnings statement. The page is headed 'EARNINGS STATEMENT' and 'Pay Stub'. It covers a single pay period (e.g. 'Jan 1 - Jan 15') with a pay date and check number, an Earnings section with hours and rate, a Deductions section (federal income tax, social security, Medicare, health insurance), and a bold 'NET PAY' total. Match ONLY a per-pay-period pay stub / earnings statement. Do NOT match a W-2 (a W-2 is an annual tax form with numbered boxes and an EIN/SSN, not a single pay period).

stages.ask: Is this page a pay stub / earnings statement for a single pay period? Look for the heading 'EARNINGS STATEMENT' and 'Pay Stub', a pay period and pay date, an Earnings section, a Deductions section, and a bold 'NET PAY' total. It must NOT be a W-2 annual tax form.

is_pay_stub.description: yes if this is a per-pay-period pay stub, otherwise no

doc_type.description: a short kebab-case token naming the document type
doc_type.values: a short kebab-case token, e.g. earnings-statement

year.description: the 4-digit year of the pay date

rules.label: insurance-eob
rules.name: Health Insurance Explanation of Benefits
rules.instruction: A health insurance Explanation of Benefits (EOB). The header names a health plan/insurer (for example 'Sample Health Plan') and reads 'EXPLANATION OF BENEFITS', usually with the disclaimer 'THIS IS NOT A BILL'. It shows a member name, a member ID, a claim number, a provider, a date of service, and a benefits table with columns 'BILLED', 'PLAN PAID', and 'YOU OWE', ending in a 'TOTAL PATIENT RESPONSIBILITY' amount. Match ONLY a health insurance EOB. Do NOT match a bank statement or a utility bill.

stages.ask: Is this page a health insurance Explanation of Benefits (EOB)? Look for a health plan/insurer name, 'EXPLANATION OF BENEFITS', the words 'THIS IS NOT A BILL', a member ID, a claim number, and a benefits table with 'BILLED', 'PLAN PAID' and 'YOU OWE' columns.

is_eob.description: yes if this is a health insurance Explanation of Benefits, otherwise no

doc_type.description: a short kebab-case token naming the document type
doc_type.values: a short kebab-case token, e.g. explanation-of-benefits

year.description: the 4-digit year of the date of service

rules.label: vehicle-registration
rules.name: Vehicle Registration Certificate
rules.instruction: A vehicle registration certificate issued by a Department of Motor Vehicles. The page has a decorative certificate border, a 'DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES' line, and a large heading 'VEHICLE REGISTRATION' / 'Certificate of Registration'. It shows a license plate number, a registration year, a registered owner, a VIN, a vehicle make/model, validity dates, and a registration fee. Match ONLY a vehicle/motor-vehicle registration certificate. Do NOT match any financial, tax, medical, or utility document.

stages.ask: Is this page a vehicle registration certificate? Look for a 'DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES' line, the heading 'VEHICLE REGISTRATION', a license plate number, a VIN, a vehicle make/model, and a registration year.

is_vehicle_registration.description: yes if this is a vehicle registration certificate, otherwise no

doc_type.description: a short kebab-case token naming the document type
doc_type.values: a short kebab-case token, e.g. registration-certificate
